description: Steam locomotive drawings and railway plans is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Queensland State Archives. This dataset was compiled from records held at Queensland State Archives: series relating to steam locomotive drawings, Series 17695, and to railway plans and sections, Series 17676 and Series 17692, as kept by the Railway Department, now Queensland Rail, during the period 1864 to 1999. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under the publisher Queensland State Archives. Its tags are Queensland Rail, Queensland State Archives, archives, government, locomotive. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
